rating.comments: The student gives reasons for both sides, e.g. "Positivo porque puede enseñarte cosas, inspirarte" and "pero negativo porque hay gente que no sabe usarlas", and a multi-part justification with examples in "Pues si por ejemplo hay una persona que les inspira... traumas porque al no ser que tengas contrl parental". Knowledge building is mainly extension of the student's own ideas (influencers, parental control, "Dandoles charlas y dandoles ejemplos"), with no real reuse of the AI's wording beyond echoing a prompt. Several replies are repetitions ("Como he dicho antes" twice), but the student made several full task-focused attempts and kept responding after prompts. No student message asks a content question; "tengo una pregunta" was procedural and the pasted task question does not count.
